editorial:
Imagine you are feeling totally lost after a big loss, and then a weird, glowing carnival just pops up in your hometown overnight. That is exactly where you find yourself as the main character, a young woman who is just looking for some peace. You will quickly see that this isn't your normal fair with cotton candy and rides. Instead, it is a flashy trap run by vampires who know exactly how to play on your emotions. The vibe is a mix of a dark dream and a scary date, making you feel both attracted to the danger and terrified of what is hiding behind the colorful tents.

You will love how the lead actress sells the feeling of being tricked by love, and the twists in the second half really keep you guessing. While some of the slow parts in the middle might drag, the scary scenes make up for it. If you have a nice TV, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the bright neon lights. You could also rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like owning your movies.
endingExplained: You will find out that the carnival is actually a giant feeding ground. In the final scene, the lead woman discovers her new lover was only using her to keep the other vampires fed. She manages to set the main tent on fire, killing the leader. However, the twist is that she survives by drinking the leader's blood, turning into a vampire herself. She ends up taking over the carnival to start her own dark empire.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark romance and vampire stories.
